capabilities: Jump the cursor to the next or previous list item or heading at the same level
Jump the cursor to a lower or upper outline level
extras: The README lists its commands and shows demo videos, but does not mention which default hotkeys are assigned.
intentEvidence: I want to move my cusor like Excel Ctrl + ↑ ↓ ← →
motivation: The author wanted cursor movement "like Excel Ctrl + ↑ ↓ ← →".
problem: Obsidian lacks Excel-style Ctrl+arrow jumps that move the cursor between list items and headings by outline level.
summary: Keyboard-driven navigation plugin that jumps the cursor between list items and headings at the same or adjacent outline levels.
